reviewMethod: Actually viewed each final PNG with view_image and compared it with saved prompts, existing HaoStrike style reference and missing-audit actual effects. No images regenerated or modified.
scope: Nine root-group final illustrations; semantic and visual regression, not gameplay-rule transcription.

entries.title: 菜
entries.nameAndPrompt: Training targets, awkward low crouch and embarrassed sweat convey a novice; oversized protective shield and purple wrist ribbon match weak-for-block concept.
entries.anatomy: One complete crouching body; front hand grips sword naturally, other arm supports the lowered posture beside the shield. No extra arms or visible malformed fingers.
entries.style: Ash-blond amber-eyed blue-hooded protagonist, blue/gold angular paint and dark outfit consistent with reference.

entries.title: 答疑
entries.nameAndPrompt: Hero explains a floating geometric problem at a lecture desk to two seated listeners. Sword acts as a pointer; light and dark puzzle fragments support risk/reward theme without confusing the tutoring motif.
entries.anatomy: Sword hand and open explanatory hand each attach to one arm; listeners are coherent foreground back views. No extra limbs.
entries.style: Consistent protagonist and blue/gold painterly rendering; lecture scene clearly differs from generic combat art.

entries.title: 更猛烈的炸鱼
entries.nameAndPrompt: Many small fish-shaped wooden targets swept through an enormous curling blue/gold wave; hero remains intact and raises a gold-edged blank card. Clearly stronger and more expansive than ordinary Smurfing.
entries.anatomy: One sword-holding arm and one raised card-holding arm; coherent shoulders, hands and standing torso. No extra arms.
entries.style: Consistent blue hood, blond hair, black outfit and bold paint; exaggerated scale fits playful overkill theme.

entries.title: 自挂东南枝
entries.nameAndPrompt: Spare blue cloak hangs from a tree branch; grounded hero releases luminous power cards while other cards and shield disintegrate. A coherent creative interpretation of the ambiguous title and all-in effect.
entries.anatomy: Foreground open palm has five plausible digits; waist-side hand and its forearm are separate and coherent. One body with normal legs, no duplicated limbs.
entries.style: Same blue/gold/black character painting; branch and cape make scene distinctive.

entries.title: 后知后觉
entries.nameAndPrompt: Wide-eyed backward glance, nearly emptied hourglass and barrier only beginning to form communicate belated realization and delayed block. Gold particles stream from open hand to barrier.
entries.anatomy: Prominent open palm has five connected digits and coherent wrist; shoulder turn is anatomically plausible. Other arm is occluded, not duplicated.
entries.style: Consistent protagonist, golden shield geometry and blue cloak brushwork.

entries.title: 怎么串？
entries.nameAndPrompt: Large foreground fan of actual meat skewers directly represents Chuan, gold strings join them, and chin-resting hand plus inquisitive eyes clearly convey figuring out how to chain them.
entries.anatomy: Foreground hand wraps coherently around skewer stems; separate hand supports chin with naturally folded fingers. Both arms attach to torso, no extra hands or gross finger defects.
entries.style: Existing Chuan reddish meat/pale wood/violet brushwork combines coherently with blue/gold protagonist style.

entries.title: 不如你一根
entries.nameAndPrompt: A single tiny wooden toothpick held between thumb and index produces a huge wave sweeping away practice enemies; cracked golden protection suggests personal cost. Playful one-stick superiority is acceptable for ambiguous title.
entries.anatomy: Close pinching hand has coherent thumb, extended index and folded remaining digits in a fingerless glove. Other arm extends behind to one fist; foreground enemy hand is clearly a separate practice target.
entries.style: Character identity and bold blue/gold paint match reference; exposed fingertips are a minor costume variation, not an anatomy issue.

entries.title: 炸鱼
entries.nameAndPrompt: Dry training yard, tall composed hero and small fish-shaped wooden dummies; one compact sword strike hits a target. Visually distinct from FiercerSmurfing's full-frame tidal sweep and upgrade card.
entries.anatomy: Low-angle perspective enlarges front boot naturally; visible sword hand, guard and blade connect coherently. No duplicated hands or extra limbs.
entries.style: Consistent cobalt hood/black clothes/ash-blond character and golden strike brushwork.

entries.title: 急了
entries.nameAndPrompt: Angry brows, flushed cheeks, sweat and clenched teeth make irritation unmistakable. Purple knots on wrist, shoulder and waist support debuff-driven repeated slash arcs.
entries.anatomy: One near sword grip and one rear open hand, each on a single connected arm. Multiple bright arcs are motion trails, not additional swords or limbs.
entries.style: Same blond amber-eyed character; lowered face mask lets expression carry the title while blue/black outfit and blue/gold paint remain consistent.

pairwiseChecks.observed: Ordinary card uses dry yard and a small single-target gold slash; fiercer power uses huge curled waves, many scattered targets and a raised upgrade card. Both share fish-shaped practice targets, so escalation is clear without looking like duplicate art.
